mcqs.question: What happened to the broader tariff regime associated with the earlier 25% punitive tariff on India?
options: It was struck down by the US Supreme Court in February 2026
It was extended to 2031 by the US Supreme Court in February 2026
It was increased to 50% by the US Supreme Court in February 2026
It was reduced to 10% by the US Supreme Court in February 2026
mcqs.explanation: The broader tariff regime associated with the earlier 25% punitive tariff was struck down by the US Supreme Court in February 2026. The 50% figure refers to tariffs on steel, aluminium and copper under Section 232, not the court’s ruling on this regime.

mcqs.question: How will the 2027 India–Japan Year of Shared Horizons begin?
options: With a friendly cricket match during the Aichi–Nagoya Asian Games 2026
With the MAGE-75 initiative during the Aichi–Nagoya Asian Games 2026
With the Shared Future-75 youth programme during the Aichi–Nagoya Asian Games 2026
With the RASA-75 arts programme during the Aichi–Nagoya Asian Games 2026
mcqs.explanation: The 2027 India–Japan Year of Shared Horizons will begin with a friendly cricket match during the Aichi–Nagoya Asian Games 2026. MAGE-75, Shared Future-75 and RASA-75 are separate initiatives, not the opening event.
